pseudocode:
CONSTANT-ACCESS(A, i)
    return A[i]

SWAP(A, i, j)
    temp ← A[i]
    A[i] ← A[j]
    A[j] ← temp

GET-MAX(a, b)
    if a > b then
        return a
    else
        return b

INCREMENT(x)
    x ← x + 1
    return x

IS-EVEN(n)
    if n mod 2 = 0 then
        return true
    else
        return false

ARRAY-ACCESS(A, i, j)
    return A[i][j]

MIN-OF-TWO(a, b)
    if a < b then
        return a
    return b

SET-VALUE(A, i, value)
    A[i] ← value

BINARY-SEARCH(A, p, r, x)
    if p > r then
        return -1
    q ← (p + r) div 2
    if A[q] = x then
        return q
    else if A[q] > x then
        return BINARY-SEARCH(A, p, q - 1, x)
    else
        return BINARY-SEARCH(A, q + 1, r, x)

ITERATIVE-BINARY-SEARCH(A, n, x)
    low ← 1
    high ← n
    while low ≤ high do
        mid ← (low + high) div 2
        if A[mid] = x then
            return mid
        else if A[mid] < x then
            low ← mid + 1
        else
            high ← mid - 1
    return -1

HALVING(n)
    count ← 0
    while n > 1 do
        n ← n div 2
        count ← count + 1
    return count

POWER(x, n)
    if n = 0 then
        return 1
    if n mod 2 = 0 then
        half ← POWER(x, n div 2)
        return half * half
    else
        return x * POWER(x, n - 1)

FIND-FLOOR(A, n, x)
    low ← 1
    high ← n
    result ← -1
    while low ≤ high do
        mid ← (low + high) div 2
        if A[mid] ≤ x then
            result ← mid
            low ← mid + 1
        else
            high ← mid - 1
    return result

FIND-CEIL(A, n, x)
    low ← 1
    high ← n
    result ← -1
    while low ≤ high do
        mid ← (low + high) div 2
        if A[mid] ≥ x then
            result ← mid
            high ← mid - 1
        else
            low ← mid + 1
    return result

LINEAR-SEARCH(A, n, x)
    for i ← 1 to n do
        if A[i] = x then
            return i
    return -1

FIND-MAX(A, n)
    max ← A[1]
    for i ← 2 to n do
        if A[i] > max then
            max ← A[i]
    return max

FIND-MIN(A, n)
    min ← A[1]
    for i ← 2 to n do
        if A[i] < min then
            min ← A[i]
    return min

SUM-ARRAY(A, n)
    sum ← 0
    for i ← 1 to n do
        sum ← sum + A[i]
    return sum

COUNT-ELEMENT(A, n, x)
    count ← 0
    for i ← 1 to n do
        if A[i] = x then
            count ← count + 1
    return count

REVERSE-ARRAY(A, n)
    for i ← 1 to n div 2 do
        temp ← A[i]
        A[i] ← A[n - i + 1]
        A[n - i + 1] ← temp

FACTORIAL-ITERATIVE(n)
    result ← 1
    for i ← 2 to n do
        result ← result * i
    return result

COPY-ARRAY(A, B, n)
    for i ← 1 to n do
        B[i] ← A[i]

FIND-MIN-MAX(A, n)
    min ← A[1]
    max ← A[1]
    for i ← 2 to n do
        if A[i] < min then
            min ← A[i]
        if A[i] > max then
            max ← A[i]
    return min, max

AVERAGE-ARRAY(A, n)
    sum ← 0
    for i ← 1 to n do
        sum ← sum + A[i]
    return sum div n

COUNT-POSITIVE(A, n)
    count ← 0
    for i ← 1 to n do
        if A[i] > 0 then
            count ← count + 1
    return count

MERGE-SORT(A, p, r)
    if p < r then
        q ← (p + r) div 2
        MERGE-SORT(A, p, q)
        MERGE-SORT(A, q + 1, r)
        MERGE(A, p, q, r)

QUICKSORT(A, p, r)
    if p < r then
        q ← PARTITION(A, p, r)
        QUICKSORT(A, p, q - 1)
        QUICKSORT(A, q + 1, r)

HEAP-SORT(A, n)
    BUILD-MAX-HEAP(A, n)
    for i ← n downto 2 do
        temp ← A[1]
        A[1] ← A[i]
        A[i] ← temp
        MAX-HEAPIFY(A, 1, i - 1)

PARTITION(A, p, r)
    x ← A[r]
    i ← p - 1
    for j ← p to r - 1 do
        if A[j] ≤ x then
            i ← i + 1
            temp ← A[i]
            A[i] ← A[j]
            A[j] ← temp
    temp ← A[i + 1]
    A[i + 1] ← A[r]
    A[r] ← temp
    return i + 1

MERGE(A, p, q, r)
    n1 ← q - p + 1
    n2 ← r - q
    for i ← 1 to n1 do
        L[i] ← A[p + i - 1]
    for j ← 1 to n2 do
        R[j] ← A[q + j]
    i ← 1
    j ← 1
    for k ← p to r do
        if L[i] ≤ R[j] then
            A[k] ← L[i]
            i ← i + 1
        else
            A[k] ← R[j]
            j ← j + 1

BUILD-MAX-HEAP(A, n)
    for i ← n div 2 downto 1 do
        MAX-HEAPIFY(A, i, n)

MAX-HEAPIFY(A, i, n)
    l ← 2 * i
    r ← 2 * i + 1
    largest ← i
    if l ≤ n and A[l] > A[largest] then
        largest ← l
    if r ≤ n and A[r] > A[largest] then
        largest ← r
    if largest ≠ i then
        temp ← A[i]
        A[i] ← A[largest]
        A[largest] ← temp
        MAX-HEAPIFY(A, largest, n)

BURBUJA-SORT(A, n)
    for i ← 1 to n - 1 do
        for j ← n downto i + 1 do
            if A[j] < A[j-1] then
                temp ← A[j]
                A[j] ← A[j-1]
                A[j-1] ← temp

INSERTION-SORT(A, n)
    for j ← 2 to n do
        key ← A[j]
        i ← j - 1
        while i > 0 and A[i] > key do
            A[i + 1] ← A[i]
            i ← i - 1
        A[i + 1] ← key

SELECTION-SORT(A, n)
    for i ← 1 to n - 1 do
        smallest ← i
        for j ← i + 1 to n do
            if A[j] < A[smallest] then
                smallest ← j
        temp ← A[i]
        A[i] ← A[smallest]
        A[smallest] ← temp

MATRIX-ADD(A, B, C, n)
    for i ← 1 to n do
        for j ← 1 to n do
            C[i][j] ← A[i][j] + B[i][j]

FIND-DUPLICATES(A, n)
    count ← 0
    for i ← 1 to n do
        for j ← i + 1 to n do
            if A[i] = A[j] then
                count ← count + 1
    return count

BUBBLE-SORT-OPTIMIZED(A, n)
    for i ← 1 to n - 1 do
        swapped ← false
        for j ← 1 to n - i do
            if A[j] > A[j + 1] then
                temp ← A[j]
                A[j] ← A[j + 1]
                A[j + 1] ← temp
                swapped ← true
        if swapped = false then
            return

PRINT-PAIRS(A, n)
    for i ← 1 to n do
        for j ← 1 to n do
            PRINT(A[i], A[j])

TWO-SUM-NAIVE(A, n, target)
    for i ← 1 to n do
        for j ← i + 1 to n do
            if A[i] + A[j] = target then
                return i, j
    return -1, -1

MATRIX-TRANSPOSE(A, B, n)
    for i ← 1 to n do
        for j ← 1 to n do
            B[j][i] ← A[i][j]

MATRIX-MULTIPLY(A, B, C, n)
    for i ← 1 to n do
        for j ← 1 to n do
            C[i][j] ← 0
            for k ← 1 to n do
                C[i][j] ← C[i][j] + A[i][k] * B[k][j]

FLOYD-WARSHALL(D, n)
    for k ← 1 to n do
        for i ← 1 to n do
            for j ← 1 to n do
                if D[i][k] + D[k][j] < D[i][j] then
                    D[i][j] ← D[i][k] + D[k][j]

TRIPLE-SUM(A, n)
    count ← 0
    for i ← 1 to n do
        for j ← 1 to n do
            for k ← 1 to n do
                count ← count + A[i] + A[j] + A[k]
    return count

THREE-SUM-ZERO(A, n)
    count ← 0
    for i ← 1 to n do
        for j ← i + 1 to n do
            for k ← j + 1 to n do
                if A[i] + A[j] + A[k] = 0 then
                    count ← count + 1
    return count

LCS-LENGTH(X, Y, m, n)
    for i ← 0 to m do
        for j ← 0 to n do
            if i = 0 or j = 0 then
                C[i][j] ← 0
            else if X[i] = Y[j] then
                C[i][j] ← C[i-1][j-1] + 1
            else
                C[i][j] ← MAX(C[i-1][j], C[i][j-1])
    return C[m][n]

FIBONACCI-RECURSIVE(n)
    if n ≤ 1 then
        return n
    return FIBONACCI-RECURSIVE(n - 1) + FIBONACCI-RECURSIVE(n - 2)

GENERATE-SUBSETS(A, n, index, current)
    if index = n + 1 then
        PRINT(current)
        return
    GENERATE-SUBSETS(A, n, index + 1, current)
    current ← current + A[index]
    GENERATE-SUBSETS(A, n, index + 1, current)

KNAPSACK-RECURSIVE(W, wt, val, n)
    if n = 0 or W = 0 then
        return 0
    if wt[n] > W then
        return KNAPSACK-RECURSIVE(W, wt, val, n - 1)
    include ← val[n] + KNAPSACK-RECURSIVE(W - wt[n], wt, val, n - 1)
    exclude ← KNAPSACK-RECURSIVE(W, wt, val, n - 1)
    if include > exclude then
        return include
    else
        return exclude

TOWER-OF-HANOI(n, source, target, auxiliary)
    if n = 1 then
        MOVE(source, target)
        return
    TOWER-OF-HANOI(n - 1, source, auxiliary, target)
    MOVE(source, target)
    TOWER-OF-HANOI(n - 1, auxiliary, target, source)

PERMUTATIONS(A, l, r)
    if l = r then
        PRINT(A)
        return
    for i ← l to r do
        temp ← A[l]
        A[l] ← A[i]
        A[i] ← temp
        PERMUTATIONS(A, l + 1, r)
        temp ← A[l]
        A[l] ← A[i]
        A[i] ← temp

N-QUEENS(board, col, n)
    if col > n then
        PRINT-SOLUTION(board)
        return true
    for i ← 1 to n do
        if IS-SAFE(board, i, col) then
            board[i][col] ← 1
            N-QUEENS(board, col + 1, n)
            board[i][col] ← 0
    return false

COUNTING-SORT(A, B, n, k)
    for i ← 0 to k do
        C[i] ← 0
    for j ← 1 to n do
        C[A[j]] ← C[A[j]] + 1
    for i ← 1 to k do
        C[i] ← C[i] + C[i - 1]
    for j ← n downto 1 do
        B[C[A[j]]] ← A[j]
        C[A[j]] ← C[A[j]] - 1

RADIX-SORT(A, n, d)
    for i ← 1 to d do
        COUNTING-SORT-ON-DIGIT(A, n, i)

BUCKET-SORT(A, n)
    for i ← 1 to n do
        INSERT(B[FLOOR(n * A[i])], A[i])
    for i ← 0 to n - 1 do
        INSERTION-SORT(B[i])
    CONCATENATE(B[0], B[1], ..., B[n-1])

FIBONACCI-DP(n)
    F[0] ← 0
    F[1] ← 1
    for i ← 2 to n do
        F[i] ← F[i-1] + F[i-2]
    return F[n]

KNAPSACK-DP(W, wt, val, n)
    for i ← 0 to n do
        for w ← 0 to W do
            if i = 0 or w = 0 then
                K[i][w] ← 0
            else if wt[i] ≤ w then
                K[i][w] ← MAX(val[i] + K[i-1][w-wt[i]], K[i-1][w])
            else
                K[i][w] ← K[i-1][w]
    return K[n][W]

EDIT-DISTANCE(X, Y, m, n)
    for i ← 0 to m do
        D[i][0] ← i
    for j ← 0 to n do
        D[0][j] ← j
    for i ← 1 to m do
        for j ← 1 to n do
            if X[i] = Y[j] then
                D[i][j] ← D[i-1][j-1]
            else
                D[i][j] ← 1 + MIN(D[i-1][j], D[i][j-1], D[i-1][j-1])
    return D[m][n]

DFS(G, u)
    color[u] ← GRAY
    for each v in Adj[u] do
        if color[v] = WHITE then
            DFS(G, v)
    color[u] ← BLACK

BFS(G, s)
    for each vertex u in V do
        color[u] ← WHITE
        d[u] ← INFINITY
    color[s] ← GRAY
    d[s] ← 0
    Q ← EMPTY-QUEUE
    ENQUEUE(Q, s)
    while Q ≠ EMPTY do
        u ← DEQUEUE(Q)
        for each v in Adj[u] do
            if color[v] = WHITE then
                color[v] ← GRAY
                d[v] ← d[u] + 1
                ENQUEUE(Q, v)
        color[u] ← BLACK

DIJKSTRA(G, w, s)
    INITIALIZE-SINGLE-SOURCE(G, s)
    S ← EMPTY-SET
    Q ← V
    while Q ≠ EMPTY do
        u ← EXTRACT-MIN(Q)
        S ← S + u
        for each vertex v in Adj[u] do
            RELAX(u, v, w)

BELLMAN-FORD(G, w, s)
    INITIALIZE-SINGLE-SOURCE(G, s)
    for i ← 1 to V - 1 do
        for each edge (u, v) in E do
            RELAX(u, v, w)
    for each edge (u, v) in E do
        if d[v] > d[u] + w(u, v) then
            return FALSE
    return TRUE

PRIM-MST(G, w, r)
    for each u in V do
        key[u] ← INFINITY
        parent[u] ← NIL
    key[r] ← 0
    Q ← V
    while Q ≠ EMPTY do
        u ← EXTRACT-MIN(Q)
        for each v in Adj[u] do
            if v in Q and w(u, v) < key[v] then
                parent[v] ← u
                key[v] ← w(u, v)

KRUSKAL-MST(G, w)
    A ← EMPTY-SET
    for each vertex v in V do
        MAKE-SET(v)
    SORT edges of E by weight w
    for each edge (u, v) in E do
        if FIND-SET(u) ≠ FIND-SET(v) then
            A ← A + (u, v)
            UNION(u, v)
    return A

GCD-RECURSIVE(a, b)
    if b = 0 then
        return a
    return GCD-RECURSIVE(b, a mod b)

GCD-ITERATIVE(a, b)
    while b ≠ 0 do
        temp ← b
        b ← a mod b
        a ← temp
    return a

MODULAR-EXPONENTIATION(a, b, n)
    result ← 1
    a ← a mod n
    while b > 0 do
        if b mod 2 = 1 then
            result ← (result * a) mod n
        b ← b div 2
        a ← (a * a) mod n
    return result

SIEVE-OF-ERATOSTHENES(n)
    for i ← 2 to n do
        prime[i] ← true
    for i ← 2 to SQRT(n) do
        if prime[i] = true then
            for j ← i * i to n do
                prime[j] ← false

ACTIVITY-SELECTOR(s, f, n)
    A ← {1}
    k ← 1
    for m ← 2 to n do
        if s[m] ≥ f[k] then
            A ← A + {m}
            k ← m
    return A

HUFFMAN(C)
    n ← size of C
    Q ← C
    for i ← 1 to n - 1 do
        z ← ALLOCATE-NODE()
        x ← EXTRACT-MIN(Q)
        y ← EXTRACT-MIN(Q)
        z.left ← x
        z.right ← y
        z.freq ← x.freq + y.freq
        INSERT(Q, z)
    return EXTRACT-MIN(Q)

MATRIX-CHAIN-ORDER(p, n)
    for i ← 1 to n do
        m[i][i] ← 0
    for l ← 2 to n do
        for i ← 1 to n - l + 1 do
            j ← i + l - 1
            m[i][j] ← INFINITY
            for k ← i to j - 1 do
                q ← m[i][k] + m[k+1][j] + p[i-1] * p[k] * p[j]
                if q < m[i][j] then
                    m[i][j] ← q
                    s[i][j] ← k
    return m, s

ROD-CUTTING(p, n)
    r[0] ← 0
    for j ← 1 to n do
        q ← -INFINITY
        for i ← 1 to j do
            q ← MAX(q, p[i] + r[j - i])
        r[j] ← q
    return r[n]

COIN-CHANGE(coins, m, amount)
    dp[0] ← 0
    for i ← 1 to amount do
        dp[i] ← INFINITY
        for j ← 1 to m do
            if coins[j] ≤ i then
                dp[i] ← MIN(dp[i], dp[i - coins[j]] + 1)
    return dp[amount]

SUBSET-SUM(A, n, sum)
    for i ← 0 to n do
        dp[i][0] ← true
    for j ← 1 to sum do
        dp[0][j] ← false
    for i ← 1 to n do
        for j ← 1 to sum do
            if A[i] > j then
                dp[i][j] ← dp[i-1][j]
            else
                dp[i][j] ← dp[i-1][j] or dp[i-1][j - A[i]]
    return dp[n][sum]
